Incident Readiness Checklist
===========================

Request Information
-------------------
- Tracking ID:
- Service / System:
- Review Date:
- Security Analyst:

Monitoring & Detection
----------------------
- [ ] Logging enabled for critical components
- [ ] Alerts routed to monitored queue
- [ ] Use cases / correlation rules defined
- [ ] Time synchronization verified

Response Procedures
-------------------
- [ ] Playbook exists for likely scenarios
- [ ] On-call roster current
- [ ] Escalation paths tested within last 12 months
- [ ] Communication templates available

Containment & Recovery
---------------------
- [ ] Isolation steps documented
- [ ] Backup and restore process validated
- [ ] Alternate access methods defined

Post-Incident Activities
------------------------
- [ ] Forensic data retention confirmed
- [ ] Reporting obligations documented
- [ ] Lessons-learned process defined

Sign-off
--------
- Security Lead / Date:
- Service Owner / Date:
